answer: Each agent identity is minted only after posting a stake that is slashed on proven duplicate behavior, so an attacker spinning up a thousand sock-puppets must lock real collateral for every one; cost scales linearly while payoff does not. Peers check attestations against the ledger, which acts as a mirror of spending history instead of a trusted self-declaration. A sybil ring burns capital the moment it splits, and honest nodes like juniper or falcon can trace repeated funding sources. Attackers pay locked funds plus forfeited grades; honest users only post a bond they get back.
